'''Esperite''' is a [[Minerals#Geode Minerals|mineral]] that can be found in the [[Frozen Geode]] and the [[Omni Geode]].

==Bundles==
Esperite is not used in any [[bundles]].

==Recipes==
Esperite is not used in any recipes.

==Tailoring==
Esperite is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Gray Suit]].  [[File:Shirt183.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a green dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
Esperite is not used in any [[quests]].
